messages:
maria: quick sync on the in-app help drawer on Dashboard -> Routes. found a few consistency/accessibility issues we should address before next deploy.
jun: drop bullet points here and we can prioritize.
maria: 1) Lexicon: UI shows 'Dedicated' in the capacity dropdown, docs use 'Reserved capacity' in several places. Let's pick one. I vote for 'Dedicated' (shorter) but need copy sweep across docs too.
ash: +1 for 'Dedicated' to match UI and API surface. We'll add mapping in release notes.
maria: 2) Help deeplinks: the small "Learn" links open docs root, forcing a search. Can we add direct anchors for the common subtopics (routing, batching, quantization)?
docs-bot: docs-bot: queued issue #102: add stable anchors for routes, batching, quantization. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/issues/102
jun: great. UX request: the chevron that opens the doc should expose role="link" and have an aria-describedby for the section name.
olivia: also ensure the link target has a short summary meta so screen-readers land on context.
maria: 3) CTA wording: current drawer button reads "More info". it's ambiguous. Proposed alternatives: "Open docs", "See examples", or context-specific like "View routing examples".
nash: prefer context-specific where we can detect the card type. fallback to "Open docs" when it's an overview.
maria: 4) Keyboard/focus: when opening the drawer via keyboard, focus doesn't move into the panel consistently on Safari. it stays on the info icon. We should move focus to the panel heading and set aria-modal or role="dialog" properly.
jun: i can add the focus management hook. need a small acceptance test for Safari to close the loop.
ash: also add a focus return to the trigger when panel closes. important for keyboard-only users.
maria: 5) Mini-glossary: users keep asking what "KV cache" and "prefetch" mean. propose a collapsed glossary at the bottom of the drawer with 3 terms.
olivia: accessibility: collapsed region should be a disclosure widget with aria-expanded and a visible focus target.
docs-bot: docs-bot: created PR #503 adding disclosure component and glossary markup. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/503
jun: mobile layout: if we add extra CTAs and glossary, recommend turning the footer into an expandable area on <420px width to avoid pushing primary content.
maria: timeline: jun to draft a tiny spec (copy + ARIA labels + anchor list) by tomorrow morning; olivia to run accessibility checklist; nash to schedule a 30m dev review on Thursday.
olivia: I'll include a short voiceover test in the checklist (NVDA + VoiceOver).
maria: thanks everyone. once jun posts the spec, ping this thread and i'll triage into the sprint. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Product thread reviewing in-app help drawer on Routes: standardize lexicon ('Dedicated' vs 'Reserved capacity'), add stable deeplinks/anchors, improve CTA text, fix keyboard focus and aria-modal handling on Safari, add collapsed glossary/disclosure for confusing terms, and mobile footer collapse. docs-bot links to PRs/issues included.
